title: complete_post audit log emits placeholder CID and key fingerprint
description: post.rs complete_post() emits AuditEvent::ArticleSigned with cid: 'not-yet-stored' and key_fingerprint: 'not-yet-signed'. These placeholders will appear in any audit log a user reads and are misleading — the article IS signed and stored by the time a user queries the audit log. The audit emit should either be moved to after IPFS write and signing (in lifecycle.rs run_post_pipeline after step 4/6) or removed until the audit log is properly wired. As-is it gives a false audit trail.
